business_summary: Techno Alpha Co., Ltd. operates as a trading company in Japan and internationally. The company imports semiconductor manufacturing equipment, as well as supplies equipment, such as wedge wire bonder, bond tester, vacuum reflow soldering, VPS reflow, bonding tool, the microfocus x-ray system, plasma cleaner, die bonder, flip chip bonder products. The company also sells marine machinery and filtration products, including marine cranes, life boats, and boat davits; equipment for food and chemistry to be separated and concentrated with vibrating membrane systems; and solar cell analytical instruments and X-ray inspection systems. In addition, it operates as a system integrator; supplies measurement and inspection systems; develops and produces biochemistry instruments, which include nanoLC pumps and DiNa Series products that are used in the proteomics field; and imports and exports various biochemistry devices. Further, the company provides surface mount technology equipment/materials; LabVIEW solutions; organic photo-detector, image sensor, PDV system ferroelectric material, and Silber nano ink products; automatic shoe sole cleaners, cyclone suction mats, automatic caster cleaners, and all touchless multi-biometric access systems; injection plunger tip and material packaging tear tape products; filtration products; and educational services. Additionally, it offers electronic circuit printer, topological material, cutter, EMI tester, real-time AMC monitoring system, adhesive glue, and polarizer products; chemical science products; and temperature monitoring and fiber optic photometer products, and temperature monitoring systems. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
